ROOM DETAILS
============

1. FRONT PORCH/ENTRYWAY
   - Entry door from street
   - Small entry mat area
   - Coat closet nearby

2. HALLWAY (Main Spine)
   - Runs front to back
   - Left branch: Living Room
   - Right branch: Kitchen → Garage
   - Center: Storage closet
   - Rear: Backyard access

3. LIVING ROOM (Left of hallway)
   - Large window (front)
   - Fireplace (left wall)
   - Open to kitchen

4. KITCHEN (Adjacent to living room)
   - Wooden door to living room
   - Window (back yard view)
   - Peninsula island

5. GARAGE/WORKSHOP (Right of hallway)
   - Garage door (front)
   - Workbench area
   - Storage shelves

6. BACKYARD GARDEN
   - Covered patio area
   - Garden beds
   - Fenced perimeter

7. POOL AREA (Rear right)
   - In-ground pool
   - Deck area
   - Pool equipment closet
